title: Internal Sales
description:
Job Title: Internal Sales

Location: Bedford

Hours: Monday Friday, Office Based

REF ASPLIV

Are you an experienced Sales professional, with a background selling technical biased products into Engineering and Manufacturing.

Used to working in a fast-paced environment, spinning plates, and delivering exceptional customer service.

If yes to the above and you would like to work within a business that has a great reputation in their industry and offers stability and growth this role could be for you!

Key Responsibilities
- Manage and develop an existing portfolio of B2 B customer accounts.
- Build long-term relationships with engineering and manufacturing customers.
- Prepare quotations and follow them through to successful order conversion.
- Identify opportunities to upsell and cross-sell additional products and services.
- Proactively contact customers to generate new business opportunities.
- Respond to customer enquiries via telephone and email in a timely manner.
- Negotiate pricing and commercial agreements in line with company guidelines.
- Work closely with purchasing, operations and logistics teams to ensure orders are fulfilled efficiently.
- Maintain accurate customer records and sales activity using the CRM system.
- Monitor market activity and identify opportunities for business growth.
- Deliver an outstanding level of customer service at every stage of the sales process.

About You

We are keen to speak with candidates who have experience within a B2 B sales environment, ideally selling technical or engineering products.

Essential Requirements
- Previous experience within a B2 B internal sales or account management position.
- Experience selling technical, engineering or industrial products.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
- Commercially driven with a proactive approach to sales.
- Confident preparing quotations and negotiating with customers.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple customer accounts.
- IT literate with experience using CRM systems and Microsoft Office.

What's on Offer
- Competitive basic salary
- Performance-related bonus Monthly
- Company pension
- 25 days holiday plus Bank Holidays
- Ongoing training and development
- Supportive and collaborative team environment
- Stable, growing business with an excellent reputation

If you're an ambitious sales professional looking to join a business where you can genuinely make an impact and continue developing your career, I'd love to speak with you.

To Contact Direct:

Jasmine Williams Commercial Director

(phone number removed)

At Aspion, our core values have been built around the importance of transparency, innovation, passion and collaboration. As such, we are committed to open communication and the protection of your privacy. We have updated our policies in line with new General Data Protection Regulation laws to make it easier for you to understand how we collect, store and handle your data These can be viewed on our website.

title: Nursery Sales Executive
description:
This is a rare opportunity to join an ambitious specialist nursery at the start of a significant period of investment and growth.

I am recruiting on behalf of an ambitious and extremely well-backed specialist tree nursery in Bedfordshire, which is undergoing an exciting transformation.

The ambition is to develop the nursery into one of the UK's leading suppliers of semi-mature trees and landscape products, supplying landscapers, developers and retailers across the country.

As part of that growth, I am looking to recruit a Nursery Sales Executive who can help to develop existing customer relationships, generate new opportunities and play a key role in the nursery's commercial development.

This is an opportunity to join a business at a formative stage of its journey and help shape how its commercial operation develops.

The Role

Working from the nursery in Bedfordshire, you will manage and develop relationships across a varied customer base, including landscapers, developers, contractors and retail customers.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Managing enquiries from initial contact through quotation, order and completed sale.
- Preparing commercial quotations and proactively following up opportunities.
- Providing customers with knowledgeable advice on trees, planting and aftercare.
- Working closely with the nursery operations team to ensure stock is selected, prepared and delivered to the required standard.
- Maintaining accurate sales information and working within appropriate company governance processes.
- Representing the nursery professionally during customer meetings, site visits and visits to the nursery.

About You

We are looking for an enthusiastic, commercially minded individual who enjoys building relationships and wants to contribute to the growth of a business.

You are likely to have:
- Previous experience within sales, account management or business development.
- Strong relationship-building and communication skills.
- Good commercial awareness and the confidence to identify new opportunities.
- A proactive approach to developing business and following up enquiries.
- Strong organisation and attention to detail.
- A genuine focus on customer service.
- A full UK driving licence.
- Previous experience within horticulture, landscaping, arboriculture or the nursery sector would be advantageous.

The Opportunity

What makes this position particularly interesting is the scale of ambition behind the business.

The nursery already has the foundations of an established operation but is now benefiting from the backing, investment and commercial opportunities associated with a significantly larger parent organisation. There is a clear strategy to professionalise and grow the business, broaden its customer base and establish it as a leading name within its market.

For the successful candidate, that creates the opportunity to join relatively early in the journey and have genuine influence over its development.

The package will include:
- A competitive salary, dependent on experience
- Car allowance
- Personalised targets and company bonus structure
- Benefits package
- Continued training and professional development
- If you are an accomplished salesperson already work within landscaping, horticulture or the nursery sector and are looking for an opportunity with significant growth potential, I would be very interested in speaking with you.

Interested? For an informal chat, please call Emily on (phone number removed), email (url removed) or message me on LinkedIn. Don't worry if your CV isn't up to date, just send what you have already, and we can sort the rest later.

title: Sales Executive
description:
Sales Executive (Manufacturing)

Bedford

40,000 per annum + (Depending on industry exp.) + Bonus

Permanent position

Are you an experienced and motivated B2 B Sales Executive, looking for a new role challenge in the manufacturing sector? If so, we currently have a permanent position available for a well-respected and successful company in Bedford.

This role involves growing existing accounts and developing new business, with an emphasis on proactively identifying sales opportunities. We are looking for a candidate who has experience of business to business (B2 B) sales in a manufacturing environment and a drive to engage with prospective customers.

Responsibilities required include:
- Proactively participate in outbound sales activity, including targeted cold calls and customer visits
- Identify opportunities to generate new business and put strategies in place to achieve success
- Manage a portfolio of key customer accounts, maintaining strong relationships and regular contact
- Achieve set gross profit targets for managed accounts, new business and other business
- Deal with incoming enquiries and third-party stock sourcing where necessary
- Provide regular feedback on sales performance and market/customer trends
- Working mainly office-based but sometimes visiting key customers or important prospects, when required
- Ensure in-depth knowledge of our entire product range and competition
- Develop a thorough understanding of customer requirements on a business and technical level

Experience required for the Sales Executive include:
- Previous experience of B2 B sales within the manufacturing, engineering or material stock-holding sector/s
- Ability to learn technical product details quickly and effectively
- Demonstrate evidence of previous key account management
- Excellent communication and customer service skills
- The ability to think strategically and proactively identify new opportunities
- A proven record of success in developing new business
- Clear alignment with our company values of responsiveness, reliability and respect
- Driving licence is preferable

If this opportunity is of interest to you, please apply with your up to date CV today!

title: Telesales Executive
description:
What will I be doing?

As part of our dedicated National Tele Sales Team, you'll be tasked with securing new business for Cawleys, recycling and recovery UK.

It's a chance to put your talents to the test in a stimulating role, where you'll bring new, profitable customers to the business.
- Day-to-day, you will be calling cold and warm leads to create a pipeline of new business opportunities, building relationships with new clients and doing all you can to provide Waste Solutions for SME businesses -identifying customer needs while delivering on targets such as Sales performance and Revenue.
- You'll operate in a specific geographic area, working closely with our teams to achieve your goals. That means communication is crucial.
- It will also be important when you're speaking with customers you are professional and knowledgeable, as we'll expect you to tell them all about the recycling ethos and explain why non-landfill options are the future.

What are the requirements?
- Driven, experienced and IT-literate, you'll have a proven track record in Sales.
- A background in the Waste industry isn't essential, as we'll give you all the training you need. However, you must be capable of cold calling; direct selling; presenting to clients via teams; and negotiating at all levels.
- A true team player, you'll thrive on working with your fellow Tele Sales Executives and bring a creative, collaborative approach to everything you do.

Who we are

Join us, and you'll be part of a forward-thinking business where people are free to grow. In a workplace where respect, team spirit, customer focus, and commitment to the environment are real values - not just words on a page. As part of our dedicated team, you'll play an important part in the essential work we are doing to build a sustainable future.

At Cawleys, we believe in investing in our people. You'll have access to continuous learning and development opportunities, empowering you to reach your full potential. Our inclusive culture ensures that everyone's voice is heard and valued, fostering innovation and collaboration.

We offer competitive benefits, including flexible working arrangements, comprehensive health and wellness programs, and opportunities for career advancement. By joining Cawleys, you'll be contributing to a mission-critical role that makes a real difference in the world.

If you're ready to take on this challenge and be part of a team that's dedicated to making a positive impact, apply to Cawleys today. Together, we can build a sustainable future.

title: Customer Service
description:
Customer Service Advisor- Temporary to Permanent

Location: Bedford

13.000phr

Mon- Friday 40 hour week

Temp to perm

Our Client is looking for an experienced customer Service Advisor to join their growing team. If you're passionate about delivering exceptional customer service, enjoy building strong customer relationships, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we'd love to hear from you.

The Role

As a Customer Service Advisor, you'll be the first point of contact for many of our customers, providing a friendly, professional, and efficient service across a broad range of products. You'll process customer orders, manage enquiries, resolve issues, and work closely with colleagues across the business to deliver an outstanding customer experience.

This is a varied role that combines customer service, sales support, administration, and operational collaboration, making it ideal for someone who enjoys taking ownership and making a real difference.

What You'll Be Doing
- Deliver outstanding customer service across phone, email, and other communication channels.
- Process customer orders accurately and efficiently, ensuring prompt fulfilment.
- Handle customer enquiries and provide product guidance and recommendations.
- Escalate technical product enquiries to specialist teams where appropriate.
- Resolve customer issues and complaints professionally, achieving positive outcomes.
- Liaise with internal departments and external stakeholders to ensure smooth order processing.
- Follow up quotations and proactively engage with customers.
- Identify and communicate sales opportunities to the External Sales Team.
- Support branch operations, including warehouse or trade counter activities when required.
- Participate in stock cycle counting.
- Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance customer experience and operational efficiency.
- Support the wider branch team and undertake additional duties as required.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who enjoys helping customers, takes pride in delivering excellent service, and works well as part of a team.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience in a customer service, sales support, or internal sales role.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
- Strong organisational skills with great attention to detail.
- The ability to manage multiple priorities in a busy environment.
- A proactive approach to problem solving and customer service.
- Experience using ERP or order processing systems (desirable).
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office.
- A willingness to develop product knowledge and learn about our industry.
